summary: Iteration 4: Customer confirmation email + full mobile responsiveness verified. Backend: build_customer_confirmation_html unit-tested (contains name/sqm/phone/email/services/disclaimer/24h-promise); empty-services & empty-message paths covered. POST /api/contact returns 200 with email_sent=true when sender email matches Resend account. Best-effort customer confirmation does NOT fail the endpoint when delivery is undeliverable (verified: arbitrary external email → endpoint still 200, email_sent=true). Frontend mobile (375px & 320px): no horizontal scroll on body for Home/Services/Contact. Hero h1, hero CTAs, 3-col stats strip (5×/2500/100%), price card (2500–4000) all fit cleanly. Services calculator rows (rate+qty input+amount) stack vertically with checkbox-aligned indentation; calc-summary-card range total breaks/scales correctly. Contact form panel toggle expands/collapses correctly, FormRowShell stacks. Mobile menu toggle visible and functional. Backend tests 6/6 passing.

critical_code_review_comments: send_customer_confirmation is correctly fire-and-forget — exceptions are caught and logged at WARNING, so a customer-email failure (e.g., Resend free-tier without verified domain) never breaks the user submission. Good design.

Only finding worth noting: one decorative absolutely-positioned blur div (`-top-10 -right-10 h-40 w-40 bg-primary/20 blur-3xl`) inside the Home price card extends ~16px beyond the viewport. It is correctly clipped by the parent's `overflow-hidden` and does NOT cause body horizontal scroll. Cosmetic only; no action needed.

Pre-existing (carried from prior iterations, non-blocking): @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan; total_price still computed from PRICE_PER_SQM 3500 while user-facing total uses total_min/total_max.
test_credentials: N/A — public endpoints, no auth. Resend uses info.benotekbau@gmail.com as the account email; sending to that address from onboarding@resend.dev works on free tier.
